boundary: This baseline prevents public-surface drift and silent regression of reviewed coverage. It is not an accuracy baseline and does not certify unresolved calculations. Updating it requires a deliberate regenerated inventory and review.

review.surface_change: No export or REST operation is added, removed or reclassified. Per-surface API contracts are identical except for the published __version__ constant changing from 6.12.0 to 6.12.1. Transit acceleration changes implementation, not signatures or scientific thresholds.
review.product_use: The October 31 product-usage audit, callsites and source revisions are retained; only the inventory binding is updated.
review.admissions: No admission, contract or reviewed family is changed. Coverage thresholds are retained byte-for-value; fresh replay evidence is recorded separately.
review.unchanged: All seven coverage thresholds remain unchanged, including maximum_production_user_unresolved=0.
